sections.label: Threats to safety and security
sections.summary: Singapore faces risks of foreign interference in domestic politics and cross-border crimes such as online scams and unlicensed moneylending.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: There remain significant threats to our safety and security.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: We continue to be at risk of foreign parties interfering in our domestic politics, as many countries have experienced in recent years.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: Technological advancements have also made it easier for criminals to operate across national boundaries, and are driving an increase in crimes such as online scams and unlicensed moneylending.

sections.label: Gambling, fire safety, foreign interference laws
sections.summary: MHA will amend gambling laws, form a new Gambling Regulatory Authority, enhance fire safety rules, and consider legislation against foreign interference.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: MHA will amend gambling-related legislations, and reconstitute the Casino Regulatory Authority to form the new Gambling Regulatory Authority, which will have an expanded mandate to regulate the entire gambling landscape in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: We will enhance the fire safety regulatory regime and strengthen the Singapore Civil Defence Force’s (SCDF) investigative and enforcement powers against fire safety violations.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: We will consider the need for new legislation to better guard against foreign interference in our domestic politics, and counter hostile information campaigns mounted by foreign actors.

sections.label: Committee and partners against scams
sections.summary: An Inter-Ministry Committee on Scams was set up to coordinate government efforts, with community and industry partners also engaged.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: To better deal with the threat of scams, we recently set up the Inter-Ministry Committee on Scams, which will coordinate efforts across the Government to innovate and implement cross-cutting solutions.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: We will also partner the community, including stakeholders such as financial institutions, telecommunications companies, and Internet platforms, to combat this growing problem.

sections.label: Ex-offender careers and international cooperation
sections.summary: YRSG will emphasise skills for long-term career development, and Singapore will deepen cooperation with INTERPOL, ASEAN, the UN and partner countries.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: As part of YRSG's recent rebranding, YRSG will be enhancing the career prospects of ex-offenders, by shifting from a training and job placement model to one that emphasises skills for long-term career development.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: Given the rising volume and complexity of transnational crime, it is important that the international community work more closely together.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: We will deepen our cooperation and partnerships with organisations such as INTERPOL, ASEAN and the United Nations (UN), as well as bilaterally with partner countries.
